---
applyTo: "README.md, docs/**/*.md, .github/**/*.md"
---

# NEXFIELD documentation instructions

- Treat actual source code, current workflows and current running UI as the source of truth. Older documents may describe previous UI or architecture iterations; correct them when in scope or explicitly flag the discrepancy.
- State whether a feature is implemented, partial, fixture-backed, unavailable or planned. Do not imply that a module is production-validated just because a route exists.
- Describe the current default experience as a no-login, fixture-first public demo with browser-local state; do not document Supabase Auth as active in the default public demo.
- Use the current Vivid Farming UI direction in screenshots and design descriptions. Do not pass off old dark-theme screenshots as current.
- Add the ADAPPT 5.0 event link and project domain accurately. Use “developed for ADAPPT 5.0 — Venture Sprint, AI in FoodTech.” Do not claim a win, placement, shortlist or organizer endorsement without evidence.
- Do not hard-code CI pass counts, benchmark numbers, agricultural accuracy claims, yield improvements or provider freshness without current evidence.
- Prefer concise, specific language, navigable headings, working local links, accessible image alt text and Mermaid diagrams that match the implemented architecture.
- Never include credentials, personal data, private URLs or exposed tokens. Verify asset paths and commands before saying they were tested.
